About the Santa Fe Road Riders Weekend Rides group ride

A volunteer-run weekend ride group: gravel on Saturdays, road on Sundays. Starts rotate through the month between in-town coffee shops, Pojoaque and south of town. No guaranteed leader or sweep. Details and weather calls go out in a private Facebook group.
